Priya Patel: Quick check-in on Spring preview enrollment drip — saw three accounts in the cohort who never completed the hands-on lab. Need to reduce renewal risk.
Diego Ramirez: Which accounts?
Priya Patel: Listed in tracker: Emberly, FinNova, HarborOps. Emberly hasn't logged into the lab at all; FinNova started but didn't finish the auth exercise; HarborOps did the lab but gave low NPS.
Maya Chen: I spoke to Emberly yesterday they plan to defer until their infra window opens next week.
Omar Khan: For FinNova I can do a 20-min pairing sesh to finish auth. I have availability Wed afternoon.
Hannah Li: I'll schedule a micro-NPS for HarborOps pre/post a refresh session. Suggest sending a short form: "How confident are you to run the hands-on lab end-to-end? (1-5)"
Priya Patel: Good. Proposed action owners: Diego  update lab guide with a short troubleshooting section for auth timeouts; Omar  run pairing for FinNova; Maya  own Emberly follow-up and confirm infra window; Hannah  send micro-NPS and dashboard tile; Priya  update cohort risk map after sessions.
Diego Ramirez: I'll add a note and one-liner debug commands to the lab repo. ETA EOD Tue.
Maya Chen: Emberly contact said they might need an SSO mapping template. Can we provide a pre-filled example?
Omar Khan: I have an SSO template  will paste a trimmed version into the shared drive.
Hannah Li: Micro-NPS will go out 30m before each session and 48h after. Will include a CTA to "request help" that opens a calendar.
Priya Patel: OpsBot, please remind owners in 24h.
OpsBot: Reminder set: follow-ups in 24 hours.
Diego Ramirez: One more ask  can we tag accounts with "needs-lab-completion" in the cohort board so renewals sees it?
Priya Patel: Yes, adding that tag now.
Maya Chen: If Emberly can't make the infra window, propose a recorded runbook + 1:1 office hour.
Omar Khan: I'll prep the pairing agenda: auth recap, common errors, quick fixes.
Hannah Li: After we run these, I'll produce a short rollup with delta NPS and lab completion rate for the weekly CS sync.
Priya Patel: Thanks team  will update tracker and close this thread once rollup posted. :thumbsup:
